    <script type="text/javascript">
  (function () {
    var BOOKED_GUEST_REDIRECT_TOGGLE = 'enable-booked-guest-redirect';
    var CDP_SEGMENTS_LOADED_EVENT = 'cdpSegmentsLoaded';
    var LD_WAIT_MS = 5000;
    var LD_POLL_MS = 50;
    var SAIL_DATE_BUFFER_MS = 72 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

    function getCookieMap() {
      if (!document.cookie) {
        return null;
      }

      return document.cookie.split('; ').reduce(function (accumulator, current) {
        var separatorIndex = current.indexOf('=');
        if (separatorIndex === -1) {
          return accumulator;
        }

        accumulator[current.slice(0, separatorIndex)] = current.slice(separatorIndex + 1);
        return accumulator;
      }, {});
    }

    function getCookieByKey(cookieMap, key) {
      if (!cookieMap || !cookieMap[key]) {
        return null;
      }

      return decodeURIComponent(cookieMap[key]);
    }

    function isReferrerBookedPage() {
      return window.location.search.indexOf('r=booked') !== -1;
    }

    function isBooked(bookingStatus) {
      return bookingStatus && (bookingStatus === 'Booked' || bookingStatus === 'CourtesyHold');
    }

    function redirectWithReferrer() {
      var referreredUrl = document.referrer;
      var referreredQueries = referreredUrl.indexOf('?') > -1 ? referreredUrl.split('?').pop() : null;
      localStorage.setItem('scReferrer', referreredUrl);
      var connector = bookedPagePath.indexOf('?') > -1 ? '&' : '?';
      window.location.href = referreredQueries ? bookedPagePath + connector + referreredQueries : bookedPagePath;
    }

    function resolveLaunchDarklyFallback(toggle) {
      console.warn('Booked Page Redirect: LaunchDarkly toggle unavailable, using fallback for', toggle);
      return { toggle: toggle, value: true };
    }

    function callLaunchDarklyToggle(toggle) {
      function safeInvoke(resolve) {
        var result;

        try {
          result = getLaunchDarklyToggle(toggle);
        } catch (error) {
          resolve(resolveLaunchDarklyFallback(toggle));
          return;
        }

        if (result && typeof result.then === 'function') {
          result.then(function (value) { resolve(value); }).catch(function () {
            resolve(resolveLaunchDarklyFallback(toggle));
          });
          return;
        }

        if (result === null || result === undefined) {
          resolve(resolveLaunchDarklyFallback(toggle));
          return;
        }

        resolve(result);
      }

      return new Promise(function (resolve) {
        if (typeof getLaunchDarklyToggle === 'function') {
          safeInvoke(resolve);
          return;
        }

        var waited = 0;
        var intervalId = window.setInterval(function () {
          if (typeof getLaunchDarklyToggle === 'function') {
            window.clearInterval(intervalId);
            safeInvoke(resolve);
            return;
          }

          waited += LD_POLL_MS;
          if (waited >= LD_WAIT_MS) {
            window.clearInterval(intervalId);
            resolve(resolveLaunchDarklyFallback(toggle));
          }
        }, LD_POLL_MS);
      });
    }

    function shouldSkipRedirect(cookieMap) {
      return getCookieByKey(cookieMap, 'wcmmode') === 'edit';
    }

    function invalidateExpiredGuestCookie(cookieMap) {
      var rcclGuestCookieRaw = getCookieByKey(cookieMap, 'rcclGuestCookie');
      if (!rcclGuestCookieRaw) {
        return true;
      }

      var rcclGuestCookie;

      try {
        rcclGuestCookie = JSON.parse(rcclGuestCookieRaw);
      } catch (error) {
        return true;
      }

      if (!rcclGuestCookie || !isBooked(rcclGuestCookie.bookingStatus) || !rcclGuestCookie.sailDate) {
        return true;
      }

      var currentDate = new Date();
      var sailDate = new Date(
        new Date(rcclGuestCookie.sailDate).getTime()
          + (currentDate.getTimezoneOffset() * 60 * 1000)
          - SAIL_DATE_BUFFER_MS
      );

      if (sailDate.getTime() > currentDate.getTime()) {
        return true;
      }

      rcclGuestCookie.bookingStatus = null;
      cookieMap.rcclGuestCookie = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(rcclGuestCookie));
      document.cookie = 'rcclGuestCookie= ; expires=Fri, 31 Dec 1999 23:59:59 GMT;';
      document.cookie = 'rcclGuestCookie=' + cookieMap.rcclGuestCookie + '; domain=' + window.location.hostname.replace(/www|secure/g, '');
      return false;
    }

    function evaluateBookedGuestRedirect(cdpSegments) {
      cdpSegments = cdpSegments || [];

      if (typeof bookedPagePath === 'undefined' || typeof bookedPageSegments === 'undefined' || !bookedPagePath || !bookedPageSegments) {
        return;
      }

      if (isReferrerBookedPage()) {
        return;
      }

      var cookieMap = getCookieMap();
      if (!cookieMap || shouldSkipRedirect(cookieMap)) {
        return;
      }

      if (!invalidateExpiredGuestCookie(cookieMap)) {
        return;
      }

      callLaunchDarklyToggle(BOOKED_GUEST_REDIRECT_TOGGLE).then(function (data) {
        if (!data || !data.value) {
          console.warn('** No data.value found for getLaunchDarklyToggle **');
          return;
        }

        var rcclGuestCookieRaw = getCookieByKey(cookieMap, 'rcclGuestCookie');
        var rcclGuestCookie = null;

        if (rcclGuestCookieRaw) {
          try {
            rcclGuestCookie = JSON.parse(rcclGuestCookieRaw);
          } catch (error) {
            rcclGuestCookie = null;
          }
        }

        if (rcclGuestCookie && isBooked(rcclGuestCookie.bookingStatus)) {
          redirectWithReferrer();
          return;
        }

        if (bookedPageSegments.some(function (segment) { return cdpSegments.indexOf(segment) !== -1; })) {
          redirectWithReferrer();
        }
      }).catch(function (error) {
        console.error(error);
      });
    }

    function handleSegmentsLoaded(event) {
      var segments = (event && event.detail && event.detail.segments) || (window.rccl && window.rccl.cdpSegments) || [];

                if (begin != 0) return null;

            begin += 2;
            var end = document.cookie.indexOf(";", begin);
            if (end == -1) {
                  end = dc.length;ß
